Subject: New vendor registration + PO requirements (Redwood)

Hi Marissa,

We're starting the vendor registration for Redwood (across our US and EU entities). Can you share the AP onboarding packet and confirm what you require to generate a vendor record and accept POs? Specifically we need:
- Legal name / registered address and EIN/W9 for US entity
- VAT ID and certificate for your EU billing entity (if any)
- Bank remit instructions + ACH/IBAN details
- Invoice formatting requirements (PDF metadata, PO # placement, line-level matching rules)
- Any vendor portal URL where we should upload docs / test invoices

Two quick constraints on our side: we validate line-level match for PO-driven invoices and prefer a single account code per invoice. Also we have an internal vendor-legacy-id mapping process — if Redwood already has a vendor ID in our system, let me know so we can map.

Would you be able to send the packet and a sample invoice? Also can Redwood accept a small test PO to validate routing once you're set up?

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Attaching our AP onboarding packet and current W-9 to this email (PDFs). Quick summary up front so your team can proceed:

- Vendor creation: W-9 (US) or VAT certificate (EU) + bank remit (PDF or bank letter) + primary contact. Once we receive those we'll provision a vendor record and share our Redwood vendor ID.
- PO acceptance: We accept PO-driven invoices. Required invoice fields to trigger automated matching are: PO Number (invoice header), Line Item Description, Quantity, Unit Price. Our matching rules allow +/- 1% price variance and require the PO number to match exactly.
- Invoice format: PDF preferred; file name convention: Redwood_Invoice_<InvoiceNumber>_<YYYYMMDD>.pdf. Email invoices to ap@redwoodinference.com or upload via the vendor portal (link in packet).
- Tax: For US invoices provide W-9 and EIN. For EU invoices we need VAT registration certificate and you should indicate whether reverse-charge applies — if reverse-charge applies please include the customer VAT id on the invoice and a note stating reverse-charge.
- Legacy vendor id: If you already have a Redwood vendor id from a previous program share it and we will map to the new customer code.

We can accept a single test PO. If you send one to po-test@redwoodinference.com we will run it through our routing and confirm delivery.

Attachment: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_2028-07.pdf (application/pdf, 520KB)
Attachment: Redwood_W9_2028.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)

Best,

Hi Samantha — looping in Redwood AP team to cover the vendor creation details. A few operational notes from AP: 

- Vendor portal: please use the portal link in the packet to upload documentation. If you prefer email, send all files to vendor-uploads@redwoodinference.com and include "Acme Cloud - Redwood onboarding" in the subject.
- Required fields in our vendor form: legal name, remittance address, bank routing (ACH/IBAN), tax type, currency, invoicing email, and primary contact.
- PO acceptance: For automated PO matching we require PO# in the invoice header and a per-line match. If an invoice doesn't match, it will route to the PO reconciliation queue which may add 10–15 business days.
- Legacy ID mapping: To accelerate mapping, share any existing Redwood vendor ID or a PDF screenshot of your vendor record. If no legacy ID exists, we'll create a new vendor and send the ID within 48 hours of receiving complete docs.
- Test PO process: Send a test PO to po-test@redwoodinference.com with subject line "ACME TEST PO" and include expected invoice sample. We'll send back a short reconciliation report with statuses.

Attachment: (reference) AP intake checklist included in the onboarding packet.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Manager, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick tax note to avoid downstream rework:

- US entity: W-9 + EIN are sufficient. We will remit without withholding unless you notify us otherwise.
- EU invoices: if Acme's EU entity is receiving the invoice and reverse-charge applies, please include the VAT IDs for both parties and a short note on the invoice that reverse-charge is being applied. We also ask for a VAT certificate during onboarding so our tax team can keep the vendor record aligned.
- Intercompany / multi-entity invoicing: if you plan to bill across multiple Acme legal entities, please indicate the legal bill-to on the PO and we will create separate vendor-site records.

If you anticipate any special tax treaties or withholding requirements please flag them now so we can record them on the vendor profile.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel (Tax & Commercial), Redwood Inference
